PIP: This report contains findings from the Service Modernisation Customer Experience Survey, conducted by IFF Research on behalf of the Department for Work and Pensions ( DWP ). Two waves of the survey took place in spring 2024 and spring 2025, surveying customers from 9 service lines earmarked for modernisation. The report examines how customers’ experiences are evolving as services are modernised, and customers’ overall perceptions and experiences of modernisation.
Jobseeker's Allowance: Adjudication circulars provide advice, guidance and information on Housing Benefit to local authority staff. They update the Housing Benefit guidance manual . The circulars make many references to Council Tax Benefit as this was administered by local authorities alongside Housing Benefit until March 2013. In April 2013 Council Tax Benefit was replaced by local authorities’ own council tax support and reduction schemes, removing Department for Work and Pension’s involvement. Readers will need to consider references to Council Tax Benefit in these documents accordingly.

Auto-Enrolment Oversight: The Common Standards for Identity Verification and Authentication ( CSIVA ) of DWP customers is under review. You should refer to Good Practice Guides 45 and 44 instead. Note, the Department for Work and Pensions ( DWP ) is unable to reply to general enquiries or questions about these security standards and policies. These security standards and policies apply to DWP suppliers and contractors only. They do not apply to other government departments, their agencies or arm’s length bodies. They have been published to help inform DWP Invitations to Tender and other contracting processes.
